privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Golify respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

infoWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
infoWeCollect.accountData: Account data: email, username, profile photo.
infoWeCollect.usageData: Usage data: matches tracked, retas joined, EA FC catalog interactions.
infoWeCollect.deviceData: Device data: device type, OS version, push notification token.
infoWeCollect.locationData: Location data: only if you grant permission, used for local retas.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.provide: Provide and improve the app services.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing Your Information
sharing.text: We do not sell your personal data. We only share data with trusted service providers (e.g., cloud hosting, analytics) under strict confidentiality agreements, or when required by law.

yourRights.title: 4. Your Rights
yourRights.text: You can access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time through the app settings or by contacting us at

security.title: 5. Security
security.text: We use industry-standard measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

children.title: 6. Children's Privacy
children.text: Golify is not intended for users under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us immediately.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Golify, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

use.title: 1. Use of the Service
use.text: Golify provides football match tracking, retas organization, and EA FC catalog browsing. You agree to use the service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms.

accounts.title: 2. User Accounts
accounts.text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

content.title: 3. Content
content.text: You retain ownership of content you post. By posting, you grant Golify a license to use, display, and distribute it within the app. Do not post illegal, abusive, or infringing content.

termination.title: 4. Termination
termination.text: We may suspend or terminate your account for violations of these terms. You may also delete your account at any time (see below).

disclaimer.title: 5. Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: Golify is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the app.

changes.title: 6. Changes to Terms
changes.text: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

accountDeletion.title: Account Deletion
accountDeletion.intro: You have the right to delete your account and associated personal data at any time.

howToDelete.title: How to delete your account
howToDelete.alternative: Alternatively, you can request deletion by emailing us at

whatGetsDeleted.title: What gets deleted
whatGetsDeleted.history: Your match tracking history and retas.
whatGetsDeleted.catalog: Your EA FC catalog favorites and interactions.
whatGetsDeleted.push: Push notification tokens and device associations.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.text: Some data may be retained for up to 30 days in encrypted backups before permanent deletion. We may also retain minimal information as required by law or for legitimate business purposes (e.g., fraud prevention).

accountDeletion.contact: For questions about account deletion or data handling, contact us at
